giver: Kenton Rees, at his Island Dreams shop by the beach in Key Lento
steps: Talk to Kenton at his shop
Take the boat to the marked dive spot
Grab the scuba gear on the back of the boat and dive
Follow the trench to the shipwreck
Use the Metal Detector in the pink zone and dig up 3 golden chests
Free Dobbs from the grate and swim back (harpoon the shark twice to save him)
tips: Hold R1 near fish to study them (counts for 100%)
